normal.description: Move and act on items. The resting mode.

insert.description: Type text into the focused field.

command.description: Type a command on the command line.

c.name: change
c.description: Remove the target and enter insert mode.

>.name: indent
>.description: Move the target one level deeper.

<lt>.name: outdent
<lt>.description: Move the target one level up.

h.name: left
h.description: Previous item on the same row.

l.name: right
l.description: Next item on the same row.

w.name: next-word
w.description: Start of the next word or group.

b.name: previous-word
b.description: Start of the previous word or group.

e.name: end-of-word
e.description: End of the current word or group.

M.name: screen-middle
M.description: Item closest to the middle of the screen.

aw.name: a-word
aw.description: The word under focus with trailing space.

ap.name: a-paragraph
ap.description: The block under focus with trailing space.

<CR>.name: activate
<CR>.description: Open or run the focused item.

<C-w>.name: delete-word
<C-w>.description: Delete the word before the cursor.

<C-u>.name: delete-to-start
<C-u>.description: Delete from the cursor to the start of the line.

<C-k>.name: delete-to-end
<C-k>.description: Delete from the cursor to the end of the line.

<C-h>.name: delete-character
<C-h>.description: Delete the character before the cursor.

<C-a>.name: select-all
<C-a>.description: Select all the text in the field.

<C-e>.name: line-end
<C-e>.description: Move the cursor to the end of the line.

<C-j>.name: next-suggestion
<C-j>.description: Select the next suggestion, as in fzf.

<C-k>.name: previous-suggestion
<C-k>.description: Select the previous suggestion, as in fzf. Takes over delete-to-end while suggestions show.
